_doc: Damage by distance travelled for a weapon's shots (Match._shot_apply: 'farf' and 'near'). A weapon names a class in its primary: "falloff" (full damage to start, then a straight line down to floor x damage at end, floor beyond) and optionally "ramp" (from x damage up to full between start and end). Metres are for a shot whose weapon range is at least the class end; a shorter-ranged weapon squeezes the same curve into its own range (scale = range / end), so it reaches the floor at its last metre.
